title.zh: Big Fish: Exploiting a 37-Year-Old Kernel Bug in OpenBSD

current_state.zh: A research post details the discovery and exploitation of a 37-year-old kernel vulnerability in OpenBSD, using the case to examine why long-lived memory-safety bugs evade decades of code review.
